hypothesis: Execute a verified numerical repair skill instead of asking a model to recompute the same correction, preserving valid collection and motion quality
changed_factor: Planning route: Luna+shared protocol/skill text vs executable VS002 with scope checks and LLM fallback

cases.role: heldout initial condition after complete code freeze

held_constant: Same input facts, privileged observations, source checks, protocol and shared numerical rule in each pair
Same original simulation, socket3, speed12deg/s, timing and success/collision detector
Same complete inline recorder and earliest-retention diagnosis
One physical execution per arm; candidate is not given a stored target-specific successful offset
acceptance: Candidate valid complete-success Episodes2/2 with no regression vs baseline
No extra LLM calls for the two in-scope compiled cases; >=80% fewer reported planner tokens
Sampled speed<=12deg/s, simulation time<=baseline*1.05, acceleration and joint path<=baseline*1.10
Same pair prompt hashes; all source/version/recording checks pass
Scope guard tests reject real, mismatched source/target/frames/units, contact loss and unsupported residuals
promotion: Only after all gates pass, set planner_policy in evolution/active.json; preserve negative-experience version v2. Actual agent_loop D calls the shared route and complete collector; A/B/C retain model planning. Rollback planner_policy=llm.
cost_accounting: Include context preparation+planner call+full collection/verification wall time. Research orchestration, Git, idle time, human cost and billed price remain separate/unknown.
limitations: Known one-axis repair family; not unknown-task discovery or new task-family generalization
Compiled numerical skill is external Agent capability, not a weak model weight/reasoning improvement
N=2 pairs; no sustained-production throughput guarantee
No real calibration or hardware use
